description: WEEKNUM stale return_type after a sheet move: Third (a type 2 marker) is moved to the first tab before the recalc; the reader on Second shows whether the order follows the tab positions or the order the sheets were loaded in. Readers decode the reused start weekday: WEEKNUM(2..7,99) joined gives 111111 Sun, 222222 Mon, 122222 Tue, 112222 Wed, 111222 Thu, 111122 Fri, 111112 Sat; markers WEEKNUM(100,t) with t 1 Sun, 2 Mon, 12 Tue, 13 Wed, 14 Thu (T-1484)
